EC1: 1. [NOT] Absence of objectionable cognitive impairment [OR] or presence of dementia [AND] of severe degree defined by CDR score > 2.0.
EC2: 2. [NOT] Unavailability of brain MRI [OR] (in case of absolute contraindications [AND], the use of cranial CT is allowed).
EC3: 3. Expected poor compliance with the study protocol.
EC4: 4. Past diagnosis of major depression [OR], schizophrenia [OR], major anxiety syndrome [OR], or manic- depressive illness.
EC5: 5. Diagnosis of degenerative cognitive impairment [AND] based on clinical and/or neuroradiological findings (i.e., patients with prevailing memory impairment [OR], or with medial temporal atrophy [AND] on brain MRI [AND] in [NOT] absence of evident [AND] vascular abnormalities; i.e., Alzheimer disease [OR] as defined using the National Institute of Neurological and Communicative Disorders and Stroke/Alzheimer's Disease and Related Disorders Association criteria, Parkinson disease [OR], Huntington disease [OR], frontotemporal dementia).
EC6: 6. Diagnosis of cognitive impairment from other causes (i.e., vitamine B12 [OR] and folic acid deficiency [OR], thyroid disorders [OR], metabolic diseases [OR], head trauma [OR], tumor [OR] or infections of the central nervous system [OR], normal pressure hydrocephalus).
EC7: 7. Medical conditions expected to progress, recur, or change to such a degree to interfere with the assessment of the clinical and mental status.
EC8: 8. Clinically relevant cardiac [OR] or pulmonary insufficiency.
EC9: 9. Relevant electrocardiograph [AND] abnormalities; bradycardia [OR] (50 bpm) or tachycardia (120 bpm) under resting conditions.
EC10: 10. Myocardial infarction within the past 6 months.
EC12: 12. Severe [OR]/untreated blood pressure (systolic 180 mm Hg, diastolic 95 mm Hg).
EC20: 20. Coexistent serious illnesses that would imply a drop-out before the end of the trial.
